start.dialog: I need kraken ink for my... special performances. The stuff is priceless—magical properties, you see? There's a young kraken that sometimes surfaces near the Siren's Call reef. If you can collect some of its ink without hurting it... well, I'd make it worth your while!
start.objective: Collect kraken ink from the Siren's Call reef

progress.dialog: The kraken is playful but dangerous! It's spraying ink everywhere! Try to collect it in these enchanted vials—if you can get close enough without getting wrapped in a tentacle!
progress.objective: Fill 3 enchanted vials with kraken ink

complete.dialog: Pure kraken ink! Magnificent! This will make my snakes absolutely mesmerizing! Here's your payment—and take this Kraken Ink Tattoo. It's permanent, and lets you blind enemies with a spray of magical ink once per day!

party_comments.kade: Playing tag with a kraken. Just a normal Tuesday in Tide!
party_comments.twist: That tentacle nearly crushed me. I need a bath.
party_comments.nix7: Cephalopod defensive mechanisms: extraordinary. Ink properties: magical.
